recipe.visualDefinition: A surrealist photographic composition featuring three iterations of the same male subject at varying scales and distances, set against a minimalist, off-white architectural background with arched and geometric forms. The typography is tightly packed and positioned at the top right, creating a heavy header against the light background.
coreVisualRelationships: Triadic repetition of the subject in decreasing scale to imply depth
High contrast between dark navy clothing and pale cream architecture
Tight, overlapping typography integrated into the upper negative space
Static, direct-gaze portraits creating a psychological tension
coreInvariants: Lack of vibrant colors, relying on value contrast

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large bust-up portrait in the left foreground; medium waist-up portrait in the center-midground; small full-body figure on a ledge in the upper background.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large face in the lower-left foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large face, moves diagonally up to the medium figure, then to the small figure, and finally to the dense text block at the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive pale architectural surfaces on the right and center provide breathing room for the dense text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cream/Off-white background providing a neutral canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Navy/Black for the subject's clothing and hair.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout; high value contrast between the subject and the environment.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to muted earth tones and deep blues

letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight tracking (touching or overlapping characters)

typesetting.case: Sentence case for names, Title case for titles

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in different weights or sizes for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Tight kerning as a stylistic texture

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the mid-century editorial weight and feel.
Provides the necessary geometric neutrality and weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a surrealist photo of a man in a dark navy turtleneck repeated three times at different scales (large foreground, medium midground, small background) against a minimalist off-white brutalist building with an arch. Soft, overcast lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add extra-bold geometric sans-serif text in the top right corner. Set the tracking so tight that the letters almost touch. Use solid black for the font color.

verificationChecks: Is the text tracking extremely tight?
Are there three distinct scales of the subject?
Is the background a pale, architectural cream color?

mustRedesign: Avoid specific artist names or song titles
Avoid the specific record label logo in the bottom right
postGenerationChecks: Subject appears three times at different distances
Lighting is flat and soft without harsh shadows
Color palette is restricted to cream, navy, and black
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Surrealist Multi-Scale Portraiture] with [Minimalist Brutalist Architecture] and [Tight-Kerned Geometric Sans-Serif Header] using a [High Contrast Muted Palette].
